title: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Temporal Modeling for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.05066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As the scale of video surveillance data outpaces manual annotation capacities, weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD) has emerged as a critical research frontier. Most existing approaches formulate WSVAD within a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that relies on rigid, hand-crafted temporal priors to supervise anomaly scoring. However, such formulations exhibit limited adaptability to the wide variation in anomaly durations and temporal dynamics observed in real-world videos, often leading to unstable or unreliable snippet-level predictions. To address this limitation, we propose an adaptive temporal modeling framework for WSVAD that explicitly accounts for variations in video dynamics across multiple temporal granularities. translated_title: 面向弱监督视频异常检测的自适应多粒度时间建模
translated_abstract: 随着视频监控数据规模的扩张超出了人工标注的能力，弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）已成为一个关键的研究前沿。大多数现有方法在多示例学习（MIL）框架内构建WSVAD，依赖僵化的、手工设计的时间先验来监督异常评分。然而，这种建模方式对真实世界视频中异常持续时间和时间动态的巨大差异适应性有限，常常导致片段级预测不稳定或不可靠。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一种面向WSVAD的自适应时间建模框架，该框架显式地考虑了多个时间粒度上视频动态的变化。首先，我们引入了一个时间精炼模块（TRM），利用动态位置编码和可学习的类别标记来建模长程时间依赖，同时提炼出稳定的……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种弱监督视频异常检测的自适应多粒度时间建模框架，通过引入基于动态位置编码和可学习类别标记的时间精炼模块（TRM），克服了传统MIL框架中固定手工时间先验难以适应真实视频中异常时长和动态变化的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes an adaptive multi-granularity temporal modeling framework for weakly supervised video anomaly detection, which introduces a Temporal Refinement Module (TRM) leveraging dynamic positional encoding and a learnable class token to overcome the limitation of rigid hand-crafted temporal priors in adapting to diverse anomaly durations and temporal dynamics.
